card.name: Linking words before female partners
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, whose, for, to) right after men or males or condoms, where the next word is likely to be female, woman or partner. Mostly in pregnancy and contraception advice about male patients.

modes.label: Males with female partners
modes.description: A linking word after males or men that leads into female partners.
modes.example: Advise males<< with>> female partners of reproductive potential to use effective

modes.label: Condoms with a pregnant partner
modes.description: The word with after condoms, leading to a pregnant or female partner.
modes.example: to use condoms<< with>> a pregnant partner or a female partner of

modes.label: Love for a woman
modes.description: A linking word in general text where a woman is about to be named.
modes.example: Both write of their deep love<< for>> a named woman

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict woman, women or female as the next word, and away from male-partner words.
card.plain: It fires on small words that come just before a mention of a woman or female partner.
